definition: Traumatic grief is a grief-related mental disorder marked by enduring, intense longing for what was lost or persistent focus on the loss and how it happened, severe enough to disrupt work, relationships, or daily life. It may also involve a shaken sense of self, disbelief, staying away from reminders, trouble adapting, emotional pain or emptiness, loneliness, or a sense that life has no meaning.
